# 5.9 抽象类

```
public class AbstractClass {
    /**
     * @param args
     */
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // TODO Auto-generated method stub
        Stack s=new Stack();
        s.put("harbin");
        s.put("institutue");
        s.put("of");
        s.put("technology");
        System.out.println(s.get());
        System.out.println(s.get());
        System.out.println(s.get());
        System.out.println(s.get());

        Queue q=new Queue();
        q.put("harbin");
        q.put("institutue");
        q.put("of");
        q.put("technology");
        System.out.println(q.get());
        System.out.println(q.get());
        System.out.println(q.get());
        System.out.println(q.get());
    }
}
```
